items.title: Will the three-week break put more pressure on managers?
items.description: So far this season two coaches have lost their jobs, but plenty of others will be looking over their shoulders heading into the new, extended international break.

items.title: Colwill's 'surreal' Ronaldo and Haaland ambition
items.description: In just 12 months, the Cardiff City midfielder has gone from League One football to the prospect of facing Cristiano Ronaldo and Erling Haaland.

items.title: How Newcastle unpicked Hull's back three - Shearer
items.description: Alan Shearer talking on how Newcastle United unlocked Hulls defence in there 2-1 win on Match of the Day.

items.title: How Villa's Jackson left Spurs 'battered' - Shearer
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Alan Shearer praises the performance of Aston Villa's Nicolas Jackson, saying Tottenham's centre-halves "couldn't keep up" with the 25-year-old striker.

items.title: Arsenal score last-minute equaliser to deny Man Utd first WSL win
items.description: Arsenal steal a last gasp leveller through Smilla Holmberg, denying Eva Olid her first win as Manchester United manager in her third game in charge.

items.title: Hits and misses: Spurs hit self-destruct again as Arsenal prove imperfect
Raphinha nets hat-trick in Sevilla win to keep Barcelona top
items.description: Raphinha scores a second hat-trick in successive games as Barcelona claim a comfortable victory over Sevilla to increase their lead at the top of the La Liga table.

items.title: 'Brave' Brighton put in 'complete' performance to beat Arsenal - Murphy
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Danny Murphy praises Brighton's "incredible" performance in their 3-0 win over Arsenal, predicting they will cause problems for Premier League teams this season.

items.title: Arsenal may move for Endrick in January - Sunday's gossip
items.description: Barcelona may launch a huge offer for Haaland, Arsenal are interested in struggling Endrick, and Liverpool insist on keeping Wirtz

items.title: Gvardiol signals return to best at left-back for Man City
items.description: Josko Gvardiol's season last time out was disrupted by a serious injury but the defender now appears to be returning towards his best by helping Manchester City to an impressive start to the new campaign.

items.title: Carrick has faith in VAR despite derby error
items.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick still has faith in VAR despite the derby blunder that cost his side in their home defeat by Manchester City

items.title: A Coventry win 25 years in the making
items.description: Coventry City's win over Nottingham Forest - thanks to Jay Dasilva's goal - was a victory which was over 25 years in the making following some dark days for the Sky Blues.
